description: Implement MtaStsCache backed by the mta_sts_cache table from migration 0014. Methods: get(domain) -> Option<CachedPolicy>, store(domain, policy_id, policy), is_expired(entry) -> bool. Cache lookup logic: if entry exists and not expired and policy_id matches DNS TXT record id, return cached policy (no re-fetch). If entry is expired or policy_id changed, trigger re-fetch. Use sqlx with both SQLite and PostgreSQL backends (use sqlx::query! macros). Expiry = fetched_at + max_age seconds.
title: MTA-STS policy cache (sqlx read/write)
